title: RLS Business Parts Fix
tag_line: Lets the RLS business computer remove seats, exhausts and cargo boxes
message: In RLS Career Overhaul's business computer, a part can't be removed if it has a core slot under it, such as a seat's occupant or a muffler's tips. Numbered cargo slots also break the All Parts list. This mod fixes both at runtime without copying any RLS files. Requires RLS Career Overhaul; tested against code from 2.8.0.1.
